title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs under mass exploitation attempts (Potassium Mirai payloads); still not in CISA KEV
why: Exploitation attempts in the wild reported by watchTowr, Amazon MadPot, Cloudflare, Arctic Wolf, VulnCheck and Sophos (Potassium Mirai payloads), and VulnCheck has an exploit that defeats ASLR on x86-64. Microsoft has not caught up: the CVEs are still not in CISA KEV (KEV feed had no new additions this run; watchTowr FAQ says not listed as of Oct 22). Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade every PHP install to 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 (or a distro/ELS backport for EOL branches), restart all PHP workers, and search web logs back to Oct 17 for php2shell-scan user agents and malformed multipart uploads.

title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect auth bypass: new k0t edge-device campaign exploiting it alongside FortiWeb CVE-2025-64446 (KEV)
why: Already in CISA KEV; Microsoft is onto it.
action: Confirm PAN-OS and FortiWeb are patched and hunt for AdaptixC2 and credential harvesting on edge devices.

title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL injection zero-day exploited in the wild: any logged-in user becomes superuser operator
why: Arista advisory 0199 (Oct 22) says the flaw was detected by Arista and is actively exploited. Microsoft has not caught up: it is still not in CISA KEV (KEV feed had no new additions this run), although CISA did add the July and September VCO flaws. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade on-prem VCO to 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12, restrict the VCO web UI to admin networks, and review tenant accounts and web logs for odd paths or encoded characters.

title: Node2Shell: Node.js/Brotli decoder out-of-bounds write, RCE demonstrated on official image, no in-the-wild use yet
why: Imperva showed code execution on the official Node.js 24.22.0 arm64 image via fetch() and Express 5 body parsing; public crash/leak PoCs are on GitHub. Microsoft has not caught up: not in CISA KEV and no ITW reports as of Oct 23 (rescana, Aikido). Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade Node.js runtimes and container base images to 22.23.4/24.22.1/26.12.1 (Bun 1.4.4), and reject Content-Encoding: br at the edge until done.

title: Splunk Enterprise unauthenticated RCE via Patroni REST API on search head cluster members: public PoC with mass-exploit mode
why: Public Python PoC (GitHub murrez/pocbit) with check and mass-exploit modes, plus Horizon3 rapid-response test. Microsoft has not caught up: not in CISA KEV; Splunk makes no exploitation statement. A June bug in the same PostgreSQL sidecar (CVE-2026-20253) did reach KEV. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade SHC members to 10.4.3/10.2.7, or set [postgres] disabled = true if Edge Processor/OpAmp/SPL2 pipelines are unused, and firewall Patroni/etcd ports to SHC peers only.

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Horizon3 published a working PoC (Oct 20) for unauthenticated RCE via the phQueryMaster gRPC service on tcp/27918. Microsoft has not caught up: not in CISA KEV and Fortinet says not known exploited. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade FortiSIEM 7.5.0 to 7.5.1, block tcp/27918 from untrusted networks, and check timestamps on /opt/charting/redishb.sh and /opt/phoenix/bin/phLicenseTool.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: credential-stealing release on PyPI and Docker; LiteLLM now suspects GitHub token leaked via AI gateway logs
why: Malicious 1.107.0 release with a credential stealer/backdoor was published Oct 21 and stolen cloud credentials were abused (Wiz). Socket and Datadog have published analyses; no MSRC/KEV signal (supply-chain, no CVE).
action: Find any host/container that installed litellm 1.107.0, pin 1.106.2, and rotate every credential reachable from those environments.

title: YOOtheme Pro 5 unauthenticated RCE via image handler (CVSS 10), CNA marks it as attacked
why: The CNA (Joomla) CVSS 4.0 vector sets E:A (attacked), and VulDB marks it as attacked. No attack details have been published (whatgotpwned), so exploitation is unconfirmed. Not in CISA KEV.
action: Update to 5.0.53 or later, then check public media and cache folders for unexpected .php or polyglot image files.

title: Linux kernel skb_zerocopy local root 0-day (ZDI-CAN-33367): public PoC bypasses the Dirty Frag fix, no CVE or merged patch
why: ZDI's report with full PoC source went to public netdev/LKML by mistake on Oct 21; TuxCare rebuilt it and got root on AlmaLinux 8/9/10, CloudLinux 9/10, Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 (bypassing Ubuntu's AppArmor userns restriction). Microsoft has not caught up: no CVE, no distro advisory, not in CISA KEV; patch only posted to netdev for review. No in-the-wild use reported.
action: On hosts that do not need them, set user.max_user_namespaces=0 (the public PoC needs unprivileged user namespaces), prioritise multi-tenant and CI hosts, and watch for the netdev skb_zerocopy fix to reach distro kernels.

title: 22 newly assigned CVEs for legacy web apps carry Shadowserver-observed exploitation evidence (DedeCMS, FineReport, Weaver E-cology and others)
why: NVD descriptions for 22 CVEs published Oct 22 state that exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation (mostly Oct 2023; Weaver E-cology CVE-2025-71434 in July 2026). None is in CISA KEV.
action: Search your asset inventory for these products, especially Weaver E-cology (fix 10.76) and FineReport/DedeCMS, and patch or retire internet-facing instances.

title: GitLab CE/EE unauthenticated RCE via Onigmo regex integer overflow (CVSS 10), all versions since 7.0
why: GitLab's Oct 21 critical advisory discloses an unauthenticated CVSS 10 RCE. Microsoft has not caught up: not in CISA KEV; no public PoC or ITW yet (SOC Prime, Safeguard, Oct 22). The previous GitLab KEV entry (CVE-2026-85706) was added one day after disclosure. Not a Microsoft product.
action: Upgrade self-managed GitLab (including Geo/DR/test instances) to the Oct 21 fixed release for your line and deploy GitLab's 'Onigmo native worker crash' detection.

title: Unpatched Linux KSMBD RCEs (ZDI-CAN-33774 pre-auth, ZDI-CAN-33549 SMB Direct, CVSS 9.0) public on LKML with no mainline fix
why: ZDI reports for two CVSS 9.0 ksmbd bugs, with analysis and PoC source, are public on kernel lists. Microsoft has not caught up: no CVE, no mainline fix, not in KEV. The public PoCs show a kernel heap leak and crashes, not code execution; no in-the-wild use reported.
action: Check for ksmbd (systemctl is-active ksmbd; lsmod | grep ksmbd); disable and mask it where unneeded, and keep port 445 off untrusted networks.

title: Railway PaaS breach: intruder accessed and partly decrypted customer environment variables (API keys, DB and registry credentials)
why: Railway disclosed on Oct 21 that an unauthorized party reached the systems storing customer environment variables and got decrypted values for some of them. BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, TechCrunch and GitGuardian all covered it, and one researcher reports related crypto-wallet theft (not independently verified). This is a platform breach, not a CVE, so there is no CISA KEV entry and no Microsoft advisory, and no Microsoft detection guidance was seen.
action: Rotate every secret stored in Railway variables at the upstream provider first (AWS/GCP/GitHub/AI keys, DB and registry credentials), then redeploy, and review provider-side logs and billing from Oct 21 onward.
